hooks.command:
changed=$(git diff HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(backend/app/(models|routers|schemas|services|strava|tasks\.py|utils\.py|config\.py|main\.py)|frontend/src/)' || true); docs_changed=$(git diff HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^docs/' || true); if [ -n "$changed" ] && [ -z "$docs_changed" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"Stop","additionalContext":"Implementation files were changed this session:
%s

Before finishing, review the following docs for drift and fix anything that no longer matches the code:
- README.md (repo layout tree, env vars, key conventions)
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (DB schema, sync strategy, rate-limit description)
- docs/STRAVA_API.md (endpoints, parameters, rate-limit thresholds, TTLs)
- docs/CONVENTIONS.md (patterns, migration list)
- docs/DATA_MODELS.md (table names, columns, Mermaid ER diagram)
- docs/features/KOM_QOM_CANDIDATES.md (API contract, business logic, filters)

Only update docs that are actually out of sync. If everything is accurate, you may stop."}}' "$changed"; exit 2; fi
